role: Krishna disguised as an old Brahmin who tests Barbarika (Khatu folk telling)
look: Elderly Brahmin; warm medium-brown skin (not blue: the disguise holds); long white beard; white hair in a small knot; white Vaishnava namam with a red centre line; ochre dhoti; cream angavastram; tulsi beads; wooden walking staff; bare feet.
sourceNotes: Disguise as a Brahmin is from the Khatu folk telling (bhaktibharat katha). The namam is a design hint at who he really is.
notes: Drawn by Claude as hand-written SVG for X001. Head at translate(484 338); eyes take the eyes-open-glow cue for the Krishna reveal. No halo by design (he is in disguise).
